source_selection: Lexicographically first registered TRAIN outer configuration, not performance-selected; its six FIT and one INNER scenes exclude every VAL scene
checkpoint_selection: Existing per-seed minimum INNER loss only; report every seed, never choose best VAL seed or refit after VAL
learned_operating_point: Unchanged natural joint candidate/NONE argmax and frozen current/future-safe thresholds plus two-frame delay
initialization: Every sequence-local GT identity, first eligible annotated frame width>=16 height>=32 area>=1024 visibility>=0.5, real RGB OSNet crop, one simulated click; no error/performance-selected target
runtime: Every future frame to actual sequence end, one decision per target/frame; only sole click/anchor and current/past sealed GT-free candidates
GT_boundary: Separate initialization identity-label file; future truth read only in a separate evaluator after all compared sequence runtime seals are verified
exposure: Independent N72R21 fitting and development sequences, but DanceTrack VAL and frozen candidate pipeline have historical project exposure; not a virgin benchmark or identity-disjoint cross-recording identity test
existing_candidate_generation_policy: Frozen historical SAM3 tape, verify full frame axis, source/weights/checksum and geometry filter; do not tune candidates on VAL
